label: Main-street row of shops (small town)
description: A row of 3-8 shop shells side by side along the street (X), street faces on +Z, sharing party walls; a corner shop at one or both ends; one identity sign per frontage on the fascia (barber pole, cafe, hotel, police plaque ...), awnings/covers over doors, posters in a band, street furniture at the curb. Shells are whole buildings (building/shell) - do not stack them; use the apartment_block recipe for multi-storey.

steps.note: Place each at x = previous bounds.max.x (accounting for pivot), z = 0, yaw 0. Vary ids; avoid two identical neighbours.
At row ends where the street turns.
One per shell, centred over the door or beside it (barber pole = side bracket, first floor). Match sign to shell use; never civic plaques here.
Over entrances, below the sign band.
1-2 per shell between windows; respect civic-only copy.
Benches, bins, hydrants, parking meters at the curb line (z ~ shell bounds.max.z + 1.5).
